meta.title: Superpowers
meta.description: Registers the Superpowers skill library for every session — brainstorming, plan writing, subagent-driven development, TDD, systematic debugging, code review, and branch finishing — and injects a session-start bootstrap that tells the agent to load the relevant skill before acting. Adds about 3 KB to each request's system prompt and 14 entries to the session skill catalog. Turn the plugin off to remove both from new sessions.
